description: Standardize system utility PEP 440 versioning to use monotonic cumulative build counters (+build.r#) instead of calendar date resets.
payload: * **PEP 440 Module Versioning:** Every utility must declare a module-level `__version__` string conforming to PEP 440 local build identifiers using cumulative build counters (`__version__ = "<major>.<minor>.<rev>+build.r<counter>"`). Pre-release development candidates use candidate tags preceding the build segment (`rc<candidate>+build.r<counter>`).
